definitions.gloss: tamago kake gohan; egg over rice
definitions.explanation: an abbreviation for {卵|たまご}かけご{飯|はん} (tamago kake gohan), a simple Japanese dish of raw egg mixed with hot rice and soy sauce

examples.japanese: TKG⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
TKG⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought soy sauce specially made for TKG.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
An abbreviation of ⟦{卵|たまご}かけご{飯|はん}→卵かけご飯：07562_tamagokakegohan⟧ (tamago kake gohan), popularized on social media.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- A simple comfort food: a raw egg is cracked over hot rice, mixed, and seasoned with soy sauce; common toppings are ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧, sesame and green onion
- There is soy sauce made specially for it (TKG⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧)

WATCH OUT:
- Japanese eggs are produced and dated on the assumption that they will be eaten raw; the dish may not be safe with eggs from countries with other standards.
